# Fury Warrior — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Endgame build (level 60), 17/34/0 — respec at level 60. The decision loop walks 72 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. No party fixture places a member on this spec yet. [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/warrior/fury/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

## How the bots play it

On every decision tick the loop walks the rules in ascending `priority`, executes the first one whose condition is true and skips the rest of that tick. The groups below are a reading aid; the priority numbers are the real order. Level is the rule's own `level_min` — the first level it can fire.

### Single target

- **40 — Execute** (`F04-execute`) — level 24+ · intent `finisher` · spell 5308
  - **When:** (the resident has Battle Stance or the resident has Berserker Stance); in melee range; target health below 20%; at least 15 rage.
  - **Why:** The 20 percent gate restates the core's own: the row carries targetAuraState 2 = AURA_STATE_HEALTHLESS_20_PERCENT. stances 327680, legal in both bands.
  - Sources: [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/warrior/fury/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `sql tw_world_spell_template.sql L4465`; `DBC SpellCastTimes.dbc:1`; `DBC SpellRange.dbc:2`].
- **85 — Thunder Clap** (`F16-thunder-clap`) — level 6+ · intent `filler` · target `other_engaged` · spell 6343
  - **When:** the resident has Battle Stance; in combat; the target is attacking the resident; the target is within 8 yd; the target does not have Thunder Clap; Thunder Clap is off cooldown; at least 20 rage; not a polymorphed or otherwise CC'd unit within 10 yd; the lowest party health below 0%.
  - **Why:** Same band as F14 and for the same reason: stances 196608 excludes Berserker, which is the checklist's point that a Berserker fury cannot Thunder Clap. cooldown_ready covers its 4 s categoryRecoveryTime.
  - Sources: [leveling.md § Levels 10–19 (L116-122)](leveling.md#levels-10-19); [leveling.md § Levels 1–9 (L102)](leveling.md#levels-1-9); [leveling.md § Levels 10–19 (L115)](leveling.md#levels-10-19); [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/warrior/fury/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `sql tw_world_spell_template.sql L5386`; `DBC SpellCastTimes.dbc:1`; `DBC SpellRange.dbc:1`; +15 more].
- **90 — Bloodthirst** (`F09-bloodthirst`) — level 40+ · intent `filler` · spell 23881
  - **When:** in melee range; Bloodthirst is off cooldown; at least 30 rage.
  - **Why:** Fury capstone (talent 109) at 40; 30 rage, 6 s categoryRecoveryTime, no stance gate.
  - Sources: [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/warrior/fury/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `DBC Talent.dbc:109`; `sql tw_world_spell_template.sql L18587`; `DBC SpellCastTimes.dbc:1`; +2 more].

  - **When:** the resident has Berserker Stance; in melee range; Whirlwind is off cooldown; at least 25 rage; not a polymorphed or otherwise CC'd unit within 10 yd.
  - **Why:** 25 rage, 10 s categoryRecoveryTime, Berserker only (stances 262144), 8 yd; it is the single-target filler as well as the pack tool at this level, so it carries no enemies_within gate.
  - Sources: [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/warrior/fury/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `sql tw_world_spell_template.sql L1414`; `DBC SpellCastTimes.dbc:1`; `DBC SpellRange.dbc:1`; +3 more].

  - **When:** in combat; in melee range; Death Wish is off cooldown; at least 10 rage; (the target is not a dungeon boss or target health below 25% or the target dies within 30 s).

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **F00u-elemental-stone — Apply Elemental Sharpening Stone:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elemental Sharpening Stone (item 18262, required level 50), sharpening stone (enchant 22756, edged weapons only), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 286); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).

The spec's own guide page names it (line 297); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).

The spec's own guide page names it (line 297); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **F00u-mighty-rage — Use Mighty Rage Potion:** On a boss pull at low rage: the potion energizes rage (spell 17528, Effect energize) and the fury guide's core kit names it (line 28).
- **F00u-juju-flurry — Use Juju Flurry:** A haste buff (spell 16322, 60 s item cooldown); the guide names it for this spec; cast on a boss.
- **F00u-elixir-of-giants — Use Elixir of Giants:** HO-TKB-PLAY-340 (consumables pass, orchestrator ruling 2026-10-18: every page-recommended consumable a pioneer can get at its level gets a rule, so the kit generator carries it): Elixir of the Giants (item 9206, required level 38, spell and aura 11405, +Strength, one hour, elixir category 79). "Juju Power and Elixir of the Giants do not stack ...
- **F03-pummel-t1 — Pummel:** Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers). 193 adds the Atal'ai camp casts the boss rows lack: Heal 11642, Sleep 12098, Summon 12151 (DB, docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-192.result.txt).
- **F03-pummel-t2 — Pummel:** HO-TKB-PLAY-192 and 193 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, p1-loop v41 casting list): the ranked version of F03-pummel, tier 2 of 3 (rank 2, fears, charms, polymorphs, stuns and sleeps; 14 ids). Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers).
- **F03-pummel-t3 — Pummel:** HO-TKB-PLAY-192 and 193 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, p1-loop v41 casting list): the ranked version of F03-pummel, tier 3 of 3 (rank 2, summons and interruptible channels; 14 ids). Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers).
- **F03-pummel — Pummel:** Interrupt; 10 rage, 10 s categoryRecoveryTime, stances 327680 so legal in both stances this file holds. A bot only interrupted the mob it had selected, so with the party on another mob nobody stopped the heal or the cast (Jammal'an's Healing Wave, the Hateforge cleric's Greater Heal).
- **F03a-hamstring — Hamstring:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): Hamstring a runner (target.fleeing): "Hamstring a mob that runs" / "Hamstring a runner" (warrior/leveling.md L100, L115). Above Execute: snare the runner first.
- **F04-execute — Execute:** The 20 percent gate restates the core's own: the row carries targetAuraState 2 = AURA_STATE_HEALTHLESS_20_PERCENT. stances 327680, legal in both bands.
- **F05-death-wish — Death Wish:** HO-TKB-PLAY-234 (rotation programme, owner order 2026-10-18): on a boss of the dungeon plan Death Wish waits for the end of the fight: "Death Wish in the last ~30 s or the Execute phase" (fury.md L25), "For consistency, pop it in the last ~30 s of the fight or in the Execute phase" (L199; the 3 min recovery lets a long fight use it twice). The rule reads the target's health (< 25) or its time to die (`target.ttd_ms <= 30000`, null reads false); away from a boss (`not target.boss`, which is also every fight outside a dungeon run) it fires as before, on the first melee tick, because trash dies before a late window opens.
- **F05a-retaliation — Retaliation:** Intimidating Shout is not written: a feared mob runs through a dungeon into the next pack, and the dungeon tank's emergency list (L139) does not name it.
- **F06-recklessness — Recklessness:** Free, Berserker only, 30 min categoryRecoveryTime, 15 s duration and it removes fear immunity's counterpart by raising damage taken; kept for a pack rather than a single target.
- **F07-berserker-rage — Berserker Rage:** Free, Berserker only, 30 s recoveryTime; taken for the rage it generates while below Bloodthirst's cost rather than for the fear immunity, which the vocabulary cannot see.
- **F16-thunder-clap — Thunder Clap:** The guide for 1-9: "If a second mob joins, Thunder Clap once to slow both and kill one"; for 10-19: "On an accidental add: Demoralizing Shout -> Thunder Clap -> focus one mob; Hamstring a runner".
- **F17-battle-shout — Battle Shout:** Measured (same sample, alone): 5,010 Battle Shouts, 3,230 of them in combat at under 25 rage and 256 at 25-34: it competed for 10 rage with Rend and Heroic Strike (priority 87 ahead of both) 16 per cent of the rage spent; out of combat it is unchanged (10 rage, not eating).
- **F12a-demoralizing-shout — Demoralizing Shout:** HO-TKB-PLAY-066 (round 87, party B and C): Demoralizing Roar and Demoralizing Shout apply the same aura (MOD_ATTACK_POWER, aura 99) with different values (Roar rank 1 -31, Shout rank 1 -36, Roar 2 -51, Shout 2 -56), so the weaker is refused while the stronger is on the target and the guard `not aura_target(99)` (or 1160) stays true: the feral DPS druid cast Roar 68 times (10 rage each, 680 rage) under a warrior's Shout, every cast landing and no aura 99 ever appearing. The guard is now any Demoralizing aura of either spell (Roar 99, 1735, 9490; Shout 1160, 6190, 11554), on every Roar and Shout rule.
- **F11-intercept — Intercept:** Unlike Charge it has no SPELL_ATTR_CANT_USED_IN_COMBAT, so it closes on a runner mid-fight too.
- **F11b-demoralizing-shout — Demoralizing Shout:** `target.threat_opened` waits for the tank's first threat action on this mob, `enemies_engaged_within(10)` keeps it off idle packs, and `not aura_target(1160)` skips a mob a warrior tank already shouted. HO-TKB-PLAY-066 (round 87, party B and C): Demoralizing Roar and Demoralizing Shout apply the same aura (MOD_ATTACK_POWER, aura 99) with different values (Roar rank 1 -31, Shout rank 1 -36, Roar 2 -51, Shout 2 -56), so the weaker is refused while the stronger is on the target and the guard `not aura_target(99)` (or 1160) stays true: the feral DPS druid cast Roar 68 times (10 rage each, 680 rage) under a warrior's Shout, every cast landing and no aura 99 ever appearing.
- **F13-sunder-armor — Sunder Armor:** Sunder Armor was absent from this rotation and is in the archive twice for Fury, once in the opener ("Charge -> Bloodrage -> Sunder Armor once -> Berserker Stance") and once at priority 4 ("boss has < 5 stacks or tank is not a warrior; also proc-fishing filler"), and a third time in the archive's levelling guide, where the solo opener is "charge -> sunder armor (which is often better than heroic strike) -> rend and sunder armor again". Two independent parts of the archive agreeing is what carries this rule; the pin carries the mechanic: 10 rage (manaCost 100 in tenths), no cooldown, no stance mask, aura 22 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE) at effectBasePoints1 -91 to stackAmount 5, taught at 10 by the same Path of Defense quest chain that teaches Defensive Stance.
- **F13m-master-strike — Master Strike:** Pummel as a filler is not built: it is an interrupt, and pressing it with nothing to interrupt is the guide's fishing trick with a spell that does little else (the interrupt rules F03 stay).
- **F13h-hamstring-filler — Hamstring:** The runner rule F03a-hamstring (priority 35) is unchanged.
- **F15-rend — Rend:** stances 196608: Battle and Defensive only, so this is a rule of the pre-30 band and the aura_self(2457) guard says so explicitly.
- **F19-charge — Charge:** From 30 F11 replaces it and the aura_self(2457) test turns this rule off.

## What the bots do not do (from the rule notes)

Sentences from the rules' notes that say what is deliberately not implemented, or that name an open question.

- **F00u-smoked-desert-dumplings:** "Only one food buff applies at a time; Power Mushroom equals Smoked Desert Dumpling and costs less" (warrior/fury.md L298); the Mushroom is a drop (an open question), the Dumpling is the guide's equal.
- **F13m-master-strike:** Pummel as a filler is not built: it is an interrupt, and pressing it with nothing to interrupt is the guide's fishing trick with a spell that does little else (the interrupt rules F03 stay).
- **F18-slam:** The Flurry-up and swing-timer conditions are not in the vocabulary and are not modelled (open question in the handoff).
